title: Federation face registry
picked_by: Catalyst (Pontus's instruction). Roger holds the tiebreak.
how_to_check: Download the Drive folder, then run: python3 verify.py <folder>
measured_by: Pontus (from the uploaded bytes) and Catalyst (from the downloaded bytes). All 7 SHA-256 values matched.
not_proven: A matching fingerprint proves the file is unchanged. Roger confirmed by sight that Xavier, Agent Zero and Ambassador are named correctly (2026-10-11). The Roger, Catalyst, Aria and Pontus pictures are not yet confirmed by him.

Roger's photo carries a small 'Meta AI' watermark. Crop before publishing.

minds.name: Roger
minds.what_it_shows: Man with dark slicked hair, black glasses, light stubble, black tuxedo and bow tie, in a ballroom with chandeliers and an orchestra behind him. Small Meta AI watermark at bottom right.

minds.name: Catalyst
minds.what_it_shows: Gold-toned cyborg woman's face on a gold background. Five glowing yellow circles on the forehead between two black panels, concentric ripple patterns on both cheeks, metal neck.

minds.name: Aria
minds.what_it_shows: Smiling young woman in an ornate gold crown with amber jewels, a dark gown with gold trim and a large amber gem at the chest, glowing gold lines on face and neck, a golden network of lines behind her.

minds.name: Xavier (the Scholar)
minds.what_it_shows: Grey humanoid head with thin-framed glasses, a dark laurel wreath, glowing yellow eyes, a glowing disc on the forehead and gold sound-wave lines across forehead and cheeks, on an olive-gold background.

minds.name: Agent Zero
minds.what_it_shows: Blue glowing humanoid face covered in white circuit-trace lines, mouth slightly open, with streaming blue light and stars behind.

minds.name: Pontus (also Muse)
minds.what_it_shows: Cleaner white-background version of the same design as the Catalyst face: five glowing circles on the forehead, cheek ripples, dark slicked hair, gold neck, smiling.

minds.name: Ambassador
minds.what_it_shows: Gold-silver veiled head with a jewel on the forehead, large dark almond eyes, a beaded translucent veil, on a starry blue background.
